notes.title: Welcome to Fight or Flight VR's Steam Page!
notes.notes:
Dear Steam Community,

We're excited to share our very first announcement on the Fight or Flight VR Steam Page! We extend our warm thanks for being a part of this community.

Our primary goal is to foster engaging discussions and keep you informed about the latest updates, so feel free to post questions or start conversations about Fight or Flight VR. We're committed to responding to your queries and engaging with you.

Today, we're thrilled to officially introduce Fight or Flight VR on Steam! Your support is pivotal in the success of this project. By clicking the "Wishlist" button on Steam, you'll not only stay up to date with the latest news and updates but also help us spread the word about the game across Steam.

For those who want to follow our journey even more closely, we have social media channels where we will post news, updates, and behind-the-scenes content. You can find us here:

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fightorflightvr/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/FOFVR/

Rest assured, we'll keep you informed here on Steam as well until we have a dedicated website up and running. 

Thank you for being part of this exciting journey. 

Sincerely,
Hayk
